summary: LINCE PLUS arrives in the Microsoft Store with notarized macOS installers and a repaired Linux installer; projects can be imported and exported through the built-in REST API, and several coding and saving bugs are fixed.
notes: LINCE PLUS is available in the Microsoft Store for Windows 10 (1809 or later) and Windows 11, installed and updated by the Store and signed by Microsoft, so Windows 11 Smart App Control no longer blocks it. The direct-download installer stays available for every Windows version.

Projects can be imported and exported through the built-in REST API (/api/import and /api/export): LINCE PLUS XML, Lince 1 .rlince and .ilince files, HOISAN databases, and the Theme, SDIS-GSEQ and CSV export formats, the same operations the desktop menus use.
The information panel announces LINCE PLUS cloud (my.lince-plus.com), with free premium and AI tools during the testing period, and links the new English and Spanish tutorial playlists.
The macOS installers for Apple Silicon and Intel are signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple; Gatekeeper opens them without the "unidentified developer" workaround.
Installers and the Store listing show the LINCE PLUS icon, and the launch page cites the 2026 Apunts paper on LINCE PLUS 4 next to the 2022 Behavior Research Methods paper.
CSV exports quote cells only when needed (RFC 4180); an Excel-safe option keeps the previous always-quoted output.
The installers are about 100 MB smaller after removing the deprecated web interface and browser debugging files, and ship Java 17.0.21.

The Linux installer works again on Debian-based distributions such as Ubuntu MATE and Linux Mint (#118): the application starts from the desktop and menu icons without manual chmod or bash. It installs to /usr/local/lince-plus as root, with a lince-plus command on the PATH, or to ~/lince-plus as a normal user.
The Import and Export menus of the desktop application work again.
Saving a new moment in a register whose observations had no identifier no longer fails with "Error executing action saveRegister", and projects with category information load again after being saved.
Lince 1 and HOISAN uploads are hardened: embedded code in .rlince/.ilince files is rejected, linked tables in Access databases are refused, and error messages no longer reveal server paths.
Spring Boot 3.5.16, Jackson 2.18.11 and other dependency updates with security fixes; new /info and /info/health endpoints report the application version and status.

summary: A redesigned analysis dashboard with the T-Pattern Explorer, a predictive assistant while coding, and a quantitative view that synchronises sensor data with the video timeline.
notes: New T-Pattern Explorer detects repeating temporal patterns in coded observations, with configurable minimum occurrences, significance level and time granularity.
T-Pattern results show pattern length, level and occurrence counts; clicking an occurrence jumps the video to that exact moment.
New predictive assistant suggests the next likely events with expected timing and a confidence score while coding.
New quantitative view overlays sensor streams (heart rate, accelerometer, gyroscope) against the video timeline with a synchronised playhead.
